evals.prompt: Добавь новый предмет профессии на нашем форке, не трогая upstream-файлы.
evals.expected_output: Finds the ACTIVE modular root first (listing the top level, and ranking roots by COMMIT COUNT rather than last-commit date when a fork has accumulated several generations), finds the override sub-layout (path-mirroring folder for upstream extensions vs modules/<feature>/ for net-new content), reads the modular root's own readme/module_template and obeys it over this skill, learns how files get compiled in (.dme include list vs a per-module aggregator), copies 2-3 neighbouring modules, and places the item as a new subtype in a self-contained module folder with its own assets referenced by full modular path.

evals.prompt: Нужно поменять одну строчку в апстримном proc. Скопировать его целиком в модульный файл — нормально?
evals.expected_output: Refuses the whole-proc copy explicitly: it silently shadows upstream, so later upstream improvements to that proc vanish with nobody noticing. Offers re-opening the proc and wrapping around . = ..() as the correct seam; if wrapping genuinely cannot reach the change, treats that as a stop-and-ask boundary and presents the options (tagged upstream edit in the fork's own edit-comment grammar, an upstream PR, or a design change) for the human to choose rather than picking one silently.

evals.prompt: Надо поставить несколько объектов на существующую станционную карту нашего форка.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to edit the upstream .dmm (git cannot merge it; a conflict is unrecoverable) and routes to the fork's modular map system instead: an automapper config entry naming a template .dmm, its required base map and placement coordinates, or the simple area-spawn datum for a single object. The template and the config entry are modular; the base map stays untouched.

evals.prompt: Посмотри, правильно ли оформлен этот уже сделанный модульный PR на форке.
